rationale: The Latin anchors *unguis* (fingernail/claw) and *ungula* (hoof/claw/talon), along with the phrase *qui ungulam non dividunt* ("those who do not divide the hoof"), firmly point to the anatomical/keratinous covering on digits or hooves, not a metal fastener. This matches nail.n.01 ("horny plate covering and protecting part of the dorsal surface of the digits").
